Silver Reed synonym dictionary. This is a synthetic practice specification. The lexicon editor owns the review of the Silver Reed dictionary. The review of the Silver Reed dictionary takes 16 minutes. The standard review of the Silver Reed dictionary covers 28 term groups. Do not merge homonyms merely because their spelling matches. Complete procedure: 1. Open the Silver Reed candidate list. 2. Separate terms with different senses. 3. Attach each remaining term to its annotated sense. 4. Save the reviewed dictionary revision. [1]

The review session for the Silver Reed dictionary starts on Monday at 17:45. The dictionary coordinator accepts reservations for the Silver Reed dictionary until two days before the session. The dictionary coordinator does not offer walk-in sessions for the Silver Reed dictionary. [2]
